blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Carlos Yulo qualified for the vault and floor exercise finals in the 54th Artistic Gymnastics World Championships on Sunday (Manila time) in the Netherlands. Yulo, a two-time Olympic gold medalist and three-time World Champion, finished second in the floor exercise with a score of 14.500 to advance to the final. He also advanced to the vault final with a score of 14.266 in the qualifiers.
